## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive (Energy, Technology). Confirmation: very narrow weekly sector breadth and mixed leadership across three sectors (Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5)), plus major large-cap divergences (AAPL/MSFT/NVDA ABOVE TREND vs GOOGL/AMZN BELOW TREND) — overall mixed signals.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: CVX (1W: +5.58% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +7.92% | 1M: +25.09%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +7.24% | 1M: +15.90%) ABOVE TREND. Technology follows via select names: CRM (1W: +25.48% | 1M: +38.81%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +12.52% | 1M: +25.14%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Discretionary lagging: RCL (1W: -9.10% | 1M: -17.99%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -8.46% | 1M: +1.55%) CORRECTION. Financials weak: PYPL (1W: -15.85% | 1M: -9.45%) BELOW TREND, broader Financials 1W: -2.36% | 1M: -1.29%.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W momentum: CRM (1W: +25.48% | 1M: +38.81%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +12.52% | 1M: +25.14%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +7.92% | 1M: +25.09%) ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR divergence: multiple large caps (JPM, V, MA; see CORRECTION labels) showing 1W/1M mismatch — tactical volatility, watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but active: AAPL (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +7.25%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +1.89% | 1M: +2.94%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +2.06% | 1M: +5.23%) ABOVE TREND while GOOGL (1W: -3.44% | 1M: -10.30%) BELOW TREND and LRCX (1W: -7.77% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND — sector up on winners but internals mixed; Technology 1W: +1.06% | 1M: +5.97%.

8. Financials Outlook?
Soft and mixed: JPM (1W: -0.49% | 1M: +0.66%) CORRECTION, V (1W: -2.99% | 1M: +2.10%) CORRECTION, PYPL (1W: -15.85% | 1M: -9.45%) BELOW TREND — Financials 1W: -2.36% | 1M: -1.29% and breadth weak.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Cautious/stock-specific: JNJ (1W: -0.71% | 1M: +7.12%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: -0.07% | 1M: -4.59%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -5.97% | 1M: +3.59%) CORRECTION; sector 1W: -1.62% | 1M: +4.86% with strong bullish headlines on select names (SYK, MRK) but mixed price action.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Energy and high-conviction Tech winners (e.g., CVX (1W: +5.58% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND, CRM (1W: +25.48% | 1M: +38.81%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to stressed names in Financials/Consumer Discretionary (PYPL (1W: -15.85% | 1M: -9.45%) BELOW TREND, RCL (1W: -9.10% | 1M: -17.99%) BELOW TREND). Style: Mixed / no clear leadership; prioritize selectivity given narrow breadth.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: CRM (1W: +25.48% | 1M: +38.81%) ABOVE TREND; CVX (1W: +5.58% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND; DE (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +11.74%) ABOVE TREND — momentum and positive headlines. BEARISH: PYPL (1W: -15.85% | 1M: -9.45%) BELOW TREND; GOOGL (1W: -3.44% | 1M: -10.30%) BELOW TREND; AMZN (1W: -2.35% | 1M: -10.25%) BELOW TREND — earnings/ad-revenue headlines and price confirm risk.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +5.04% | 1M: +13.22%) — broad gains across names like MPC/CVX/SLB. BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary (1W: -3.66% | 1M: -4.87%) and Financials (1W: -2.36% | 1M: -1.29%) given weak internals.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch CRM sustain this week’s breakout to keep ABOVE TREND; NOW holding recent gains confirms momentum continuation; CVX staying above this week’s highs confirms Energy leadership; failure for GOOGL/AMZN to reclaim recent ranges would keep them BELOW TREND and amplify market risk.

CVX (+55): Venezuela deal headlines; price (1W: +5.58% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming. GOOGL (-45): 'Brain drain' headlines; price (1W: -3.44% | 1M: -10.30%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. AMZN (-65): ad-revenue headwinds; price (1W: -2.35% | 1M: -10.25%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. PYPL (-45): takeover fallout; price (1W: -15.85% | 1M: -9.45%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. BA (-55): production/engineer notes; price (1W: -2.57% | 1M: -11.92%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. CRM (1W: +25.48% | 1M: +38.81%) ABOVE TREND and Energy names like CVX (1W: +5.58% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: extremely narrow breadth (2/11 sectors positive) and multiple large-cap divergences (GOOGL/AMZN/PYPL BELOW TREND) — monitor sentiment-price mismatches closely.
